title: Jinke independent Shanghai workplace-employment benchmark v1
employment_universe: 2023 secondary- and tertiary-sector legal-entity workplace employment
universe_disclosure: This is workplace employment of legal entities engaged in secondary- and tertiary-sector activity, not all jobs and not employed population.

analysis.grid_rule: common 100 m lattice; squares clipped to each accounting support

accounting.pudong_street_rounding_reconciliation: The 12 displayed rows sum to 69.8 万 versus the published 69.5 万 subtotal. The minimum-squared adjustment subtracts 250 people from each row, remains within every half-unit interval, and totals 695,000.

topology.parent_containment_note: The available repository parent layer is geoBoundaries 2017 and is used only as a cross-vintage diagnostic; differences do not modify OSM controls.

official_map_validation.authoritative_source: Shanghai Tianditu / Shanghai SHMAP_D and SHMAP_LAN map service
official_map_validation.review_scope: only controls intersecting or within 500 m of the 50-minute boundary
official_map_validation.pass_definition: no visible material contradiction at official display precision; not official adoption of the OSM line

pudong_functional_zones.public_grid_treatment: three aggregate ledger rows with null geometry; exact acquisition and processing instructions retained

establishment_attribution_investigation.control_name: 中国（上海）自由贸易试验区（保税片区）
establishment_attribution_investigation.attribution_rule: 外高桥保税|Waigaoqiao Free Trade|Waigaoqiao Bonded|浦东机场综合保税|洋山港保税
establishment_attribution_investigation.decision: insufficient coverage and no employment-by-establishment weights; use the separately acquired 2020 statistical support

establishment_attribution_investigation.attribution_rule: 金桥经济技术开发区|金桥开发区|Jinqiao Economic|Jinqiao Development
establishment_attribution_investigation.decision: insufficient coverage and no employment-by-establishment weights; use the separately acquired 2020 statistical support

establishment_attribution_investigation.attribution_rule: 张江高科技园区|张江高新区|Zhangjiang Hi-?Tech Park|Zhangjiang High-?Tech Park
establishment_attribution_investigation.decision: insufficient coverage and no employment-by-establishment weights; use the separately acquired 2020 statistical support

pudong_functional_zones.decision: release Places do not provide sufficiently complete, employment-weighted zone attribution; fallback support selected
pudong_functional_zones.planning_scope_warning: same-name planning scopes are not assumed equal to census strata; the area-matched case is a morphology sensitivity, not an official vector
pudong_functional_zones.conservative_bounds: 0% and 100% of each zone row inside each reach

predictors.jrc: raw 2020 JRC non-residential built volume; upper tail preserved
predictors.overture: Overture Places release 2026-07-22.0; confidence summed by interpretable category
predictors.temporal_alignment: JRC epoch 2020 and Overture/OSM snapshots after the 2023 census are spatial predictors/supports, not replacements for the 2023 counts
predictors.viirs: not used in v1: it is auxiliary and the official annual numerical product requires an Earthdata credential; no visual-tile substitute was used

allocation_models.uniform: uniform employment density within each accounting support
allocation_models.building_volume: raw JRC non-residential built volume; no log target, cap, winsorization, district min-max normalization, or GDP weights

calibrated_workplace.model: non-negative ridge-regularized Poisson pseudo-maximum likelihood count model
calibrated_workplace.formula: E[control employment] = exp(intercept + district effect + control-type effect + sum(beta_k × standardized log1p(control proxy total)))
calibrated_workplace.cell_weight_formula: clipped area fraction × exp(sum(beta_k × standardized log1p(cell proxy / clipped area fraction))); equivalently an uncapped multiplicative power surface using the fitted log-total slopes
calibrated_workplace.ecological_transfer_disclosure: coefficients are identified from control-level totals and transferred to 100 m proxy densities; this is evaluated by geographic control holdout, then every surface is normalized to the observed control total
calibrated_workplace.coefficient_constraint: all spatial predictor coefficients are non-negative; district and control-type calibration effects are unconstrained and cancel during within-control normalization
calibrated_workplace.upper_tail_treatment: no cap, winsorization, log1p target, district min-max, or GDP weights
calibrated_workplace.cross_validation_design: six contiguous citywide geographic-block folds formed by control-centroid longitude tertiles crossed with the latitude median; each complete block is held out and predictions are evaluated before within-control normalization
calibrated_workplace.alpha_selection: minimum geographic-CV weighted absolute percentage error
calibrated_workplace.obvious_high_employment_underprediction_: top-quartile control predicted below 50% of observed employment

obvious_high_employment_underprediction.control_name: 中国（上海）自由贸易试验区（保税片区）

nonlinear_alternative.role: scientifically justified nonlinear diagnostic; not used for cell allocation
nonlinear_alternative.reason_not_selected_for_allocation: tree response surfaces do not yield stable, interpretable elasticities for ecological transfer from control totals to 100 m cell densities

acceptance_gate.reason: PPML and the nonlinear Poisson alternative both retain large high-employment-control errors and weak top-control rank ordering
acceptance_gate.result_use: reach estimates remain model-contingent sensitivity results, not an accepted calibrated benchmark

poi_diagnostics.poi_weighting: sum of source confidence; no category multiplier

allocation_models.normalization: each model is normalized independently within every census accounting control so its cell sum exactly equals the reconciled control count

residuals.lower: all unresolved residual employment contributes zero
residuals.central: only four bulletin-identified finance residuals use finance/business workplace points and building evidence; unsplit/unclassified residuals remain unresolved
residuals.upper: all unresolved residual employment contributes to the numerator

rounding.method: linear extrema inside every published half-unit interval, with Pudong category-subtotal constraints; rounding is not an employment stratum

boundary_sensitivity.reach_edge_method: recalculate with reach edges displaced inward/outward by 100 m
boundary_sensitivity.functional_zone_method: compare selected 2020 statistical supports with official-reported-area morphology interpretations and a conservative 0%-to-100% reach envelope
boundary_sensitivity.reported_area_interpretation_warning: reported-area morphology is not an official vector and is not assumed equal to a census accounting boundary
boundary_sensitivity.combined_envelope_rule: take the most adverse single component; do not add the independent reach-edge and functional-zone support perturbations

minhang_sliver.treatment: technical boundary sensitivity only; no Minhang employment assigned to the sliver

gdp_diagnostic.interpretation: GDP share divided by employment share is relative GDP per worker inside the reach versus Shanghai overall; no GDP result was rerun

limitations: The calibrated model fails its high-employment-control spatial-holdout acceptance gate; reach estimates are model-contingent sensitivity results.
All street/town geometries are approximate rather than official 2023 accounting boundaries.
The three Pudong zone supports fail official-scope equivalence and dominate boundary uncertainty.
The calibrated surface is constrained by aggregate controls and cannot identify establishment headcounts.
Several residual strata remain deliberately unlocated in the central estimate.
